rawFindings.title: Paginator now ignores the current page from `this.page`, breaking callers that only populate page locals
rawFindings.explanation: After this change, the helper reads `this.current` instead of `this.page.current`. In Hexo templates the paginator helper is invoked with the page object as context and `this.page.current` is how the current index is supplied. If a template calls `{% paginator total: 10 %}` with `page.current = 5` in the surrounding locals, the helper now falls back to 0/1 and renders the wrong links (or, with the removed guard, renders page 1 markup instead of the expected current-page pagination).
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the fallback to `this.page.current` (and `this.page.total`) or support both `this.current` and `this.page.current` for backward compatibility.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: A page rendered with locals containing `page: {current: 5, total: 10}` and no `this.current` now produces pagination for page 1 instead of page 5.

rawFindings.title: Paginator now ignores the total page count from `this.page`, so pages render as if there is only one page
rawFindings.explanation: The helper was changed to read `this.total` instead of `this.page.total`. Existing paginator invocations in page templates pass the page state under `this.page`, so when `options.total` is omitted the helper now defaults to 1. That suppresses the numbered links and next/prev controls for paginated archive pages.
rawFindings.suggestion: Use `this.page.total` as the fallback again, or check both `this.total` and `this.page.total` before defaulting to 1.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: On an archive page with locals containing `page: {current: 2, total: 10}` and no explicit `options.total`, the helper now generates markup for a single-page list instead of the 10-page paginator.
